rules.text: Auto loading reads first occupied node cell, at most one successful stack per input port per 0.1 simulation-second tick. Nonempty matching destination required. Only Loose/FacilityOutputBuffer; protected exact-route custody or any reservedQuantity prevents launch. Whole stack becomes one payload; no partial split here.

Directed adjacent cardinal-cell graph; BFS shortest edge count, tie by ordinal NodeId, pass filters but ignore current load, power and speed costs. Named destination requires output/Both port matching destination. Unnamed destination is terminal output-capable node other than start, but auto load skips empty destination.

progress += max(0.1,currentSegment.speed or 1)*elapsed; if>=1 cross one edge and subtract1. capacity=max(1,segment.capacity ?? port.capacity ??1), counted in payload stacks, not items or grams. 9844/9845 use segment2, not port4. Failed route retry1sec.

Authored and runtime filters both pass. Within each ID/category set match ID OR category, or both empty. Material/quality needs source-stack equipment instance. Freshness needs food status. Contamination stack>0.001 or food contaminated. Freshness epsilon0.0001 and inclusive quality bounds. Forbidden allowed if either authored or runtime allows. Range settings normalized; ordinary UI has toggles, 10-percentage-point minimum freshness, quality min/max steps.

Network threshold=min(max(1,gate.stallSeconds)), default30. Power/manual stops do not accrue timer. Eligible candidates prioritized approved, oldest stall, ordinal payloadId; keep8 per tick. Gate candidates use undirected reachability, shortest edge count then NodeId. 4 policies: preferred warehouse then loose; any compatible warehouse then loose; loose only; manual approval then preferred warehouse/loose. Approval does not waive timer. Loose locations self/down/left/right/up if grid exists; failure keeps payload.

All unpowered/all stopped take precedence. Cyclic + payloadcount>=totalcapacity + all payloads blocked + no movement30sec => Deadlocked. Otherwise max(longest stall,noProgress)>=30 => Stalled. Live UI force-discharge button threshold30; snapshot threshold30 distinct from authored overflow threshold.

Persist node settings/filters and payload identity/current+previous node/destination/progress/stall elapsed/routeVersion/sequence. Route list/index omitted and rebuilt. Restore resets topology projection and clears transient manual approvals; subsequent InvalidateRoutes clears stall timer/retry. UI/save round trip not executed.
